title: Compactness and Willmore Energy of Helicoidal Minimal Surfaces in the 3-Sphere
summary: Recently, I. Castro, I. Castro-Infantes, and J. Castro-Infantes introduced a two-parameter family of helicoidal minimal surfaces in $\mathbb S^3$, denoted by $\operatorname{Hel}_c^h$, with the pitch $h\geq0$ and $c\in[0,1/2)$. At $(h,c)=(0,0)$, the surface $\operatorname{Hel}_0^0$ is the totally geodesic sphere, while the limiting surface as $c\to1/2^-$ is the Clifford torus.
